title: build(deps): bump @supabase/supabase-js from 2.118.0 to 2.119.0
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory, plus one compensating client fix the bump makes necessary. @supabase/supabase-js 2.118.0 -> 2.119.0 in packages/client moves the whole @supabase family in lockstep. 2.119.0 (2026-11-04): postgrest per-request fetch option on .from(), realtime broadcast persistence and an error-message fix, storage exists()/upload-option fixes, auth deleteUser typing, and auth #2786 -- a `global` signOut() that fails on the server (offline, 5xx) now KEEPS the local session and returns { error } instead of clearing it. The app's only sign-out path (useAuthStore.signOut) ignored that return value, so on 2.119.0 a failed sign-out would leave the access token in storage while the UI showed the user as signed out. The store now falls back to signOut({ scope: 'local' }) on a global error, which is the library's own documented remedy. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001). Dependabot's 16 peer-flag-only lockfile entries are dropped per main's convention since #432 (ec88eedd).
behavior_change: One intended runtime change, compensating for the library: when the server-side global sign-out fails, 'Sign out' now still removes this device's session (via a scope:'local' fallback) instead of leaving the token in storage. When the server is reachable, behavior is unchanged (one global sign-out request). Without this fix the bump itself would have been the behavior change: on 2.118.0 a failed global sign-out cleared the local session; on 2.119.0 it does not, and the store discarded the returned error. Lockfile audited against merge base bb90047e by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry in full, not by reading the diff view. Entry count 405 before and 405 after; zero added, zero removed. Exactly six node_modules entries changed, the @supabase family 2.118.0 -> 2.119.0 in lockstep: auth-js, functions-js, postgrest-js, realtime-js, storage-js, supabase-js -- each changing only version, resolved and integrity, except supabase-js, whose `dependencies` map also changed; checked key by key (the #296 hiding place): same five keys, only the sibling pins 2.118.0 -> 2.119.0. The root entry differs in one key, dependencies.@supabase/supabase-js ^2.118.0 -> ^2.119.0. Zero non-@supabase entries touched after dropping Dependabot's 16 peer-flag-only flips (no version changed in any of them). engines.node is >=22.0.0 on all six packages both before and after: the client's declared ^20.19.0 || >=22.22.2 range admitting Node 20 is a PRE-EXISTING mismatch not introduced here; CI (node-version 22) and .nvmrc (22) already run a supported Node. Other 2.119.0 changes are unreachable: grep of packages/client/src finds no supabase.from/.storage/.channel/.rpc/.functions/auth.admin use; the app calls only getSession, onAuthStateChange, signInWithPassword, signUp, signInWithOAuth, signOut.

diff_articulation.what_changed: package.json moves @supabase/supabase-js ^2.118.0 -> ^2.119.0 (one line). package-lock.json resolves the six-package @supabase family 2.118.0 -> 2.119.0 plus supabase-js's own sibling pins; no other movement (Dependabot's 16 peer-flag flips reverted to merge-base values). useAuthStore.signOut() now inspects the { error } returned by the default global signOut() and, on error, calls signOut({ scope: 'local' }); the local call removes the session before contacting the server, so it succeeds offline. A new vitest spec drives the real supabase-js client with substituted fetch and storage and asserts the persisted session and getAccessToken() after sign-out in three cases: server OK, offline, and 503.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency, stated plainly; the store change is required for the bump to be safe, so it ships in the same PR rather than leaving a window where main runs 2.119.0 with the unhandled error. No existing manifest covers this diff; the prior family manifest (supabase-js-2.118.0-bump) would cover the two package files, and borrowing it is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 refuses.
